answer: Run admission as a stake-weighted beacon lottery. Each epoch the beacon draws a fixed number of activation slots, and each identity enters with weight equal to its locked stake of 25 units. One operator splitting 250 units across ten fakes in this ocean of applicants wins no more slots than one 250-unit identity, because total weight is fixed. A pigment-marked duplicate is voided and its stake burned, so ten fakes lock 250 units for zero extra throughput. Linear cost, zero marginal gain.
